lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Long before the war, a girl with soot on|her hands came down into the Vale of Bells.
lines.text: Long before the war, a girl with soot on her hands came down into the Vale of Bells.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Five beacons, Vessa. Light them all and the|south watch comes home. That is the trial.
lines.text: Five beacons, Vessa. Light them all and the south watch comes home. That is the trial.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Five? I could light fifty. Can I light|the bridge too? It looks very flammable.
lines.text: Five? I could light fifty. Can I light the bridge too? It looks very flammable.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Stand close and hold still.|Fire comes when you stop chasing it.
lines.text: Stand close and hold still. Fire comes when you stop chasing it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Ha! One! Did you see? Tell me you saw that.
lines.text: Ha! One! Did you see? Tell me you saw that.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: I saw. Now build something to guard it.|A beacon on its own is just a target.
lines.text: I saw. Now build something to guard it. A beacon on its own is just a target.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Pretty lights in the vale! Keep lighting them,|little match. We'll follow them home.
lines.text: Pretty lights in the vale! Keep lighting them, little match. We'll follow them home.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: You're getting stronger. Learn to step out|of trouble before you learn to start it.
lines.text: You're getting stronger. Learn to step out of trouble before you learn to start it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Millrace is lit! And the mill is...|mostly not on fire. Mostly.
lines.text: Millrace is lit! And the mill is... mostly not on fire. Mostly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The miller's boys took down their bows|from the wall. Nobody had asked them to.
lines.text: The miller's boys took down their bows from the wall. Nobody had asked them to.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Halfway. Your soldiers are tired,|Vessa. Let them catch up.
lines.text: Halfway. Your soldiers are tired, Vessa. Let them catch up.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Leave the boars their hill and they'll leave|you yours. Take the beacon, not the fight.
lines.text: Leave the boars their hill and they'll leave you yours. Take the beacon, not the fight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: On the far road, the south watch's scouts|saw the fire and turned their horses home.
lines.text: On the far road, the south watch's scouts saw the fire and turned their horses home.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Vessa! A spark that runs off alone|goes out. Wait for your soldiers.
lines.text: Vessa! A spark that runs off alone goes out. Wait for your soldiers.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Oops. Tents are very flammable.|Who knew? ...Everyone. Everyone knew.
lines.text: Oops. Tents are very flammable. Who knew? ...Everyone. Everyone knew.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: All five lit? Then the whole vale can|watch you lose. Boys! Fetch me that match!
lines.text: All five lit? Then the whole vale can watch you lose. Boys! Fetch me that match!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Come on, then! I've got five|fires and a really bad temper.
lines.text: Come on, then! I've got five fires and a really bad temper.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: She burned my good coat!|Back to the fens! Back to the fens!
lines.text: She burned my good coat! Back to the fens! Back to the fens!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: At dusk the south watch rode|home along a road of fire.
lines.text: At dusk the south watch rode home along a road of fire.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Not bad, girl. Remember it:|the spark first. Then the storm.
lines.text: Not bad, girl. Remember it: the spark first. Then the storm.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: What storm? I don't have a storm.|Do YOU have a storm?
lines.text: What storm? I don't have a storm. Do YOU have a storm?

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Ha. Go and wash your face.|You look like a chimney.
lines.text: Ha. Go and wash your face. You look like a chimney.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Not yet, old friend.|Let her find her own fire first.
lines.text: Not yet, old friend. Let her find her own fire first.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Just catching my breath. Keep lighting!
lines.text: Just catching my breath. Keep lighting!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey... I didn't wait...
lines.text: Vey... I didn't wait...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: No, no, no! That was somebody's house!
lines.text: No, no, no! That was somebody's house!
